summary: Validated Alur Pendaftaran (registration_flow) end-to-end. Backend: 4/4 pytest passed - GET /api/site/content returns exactly 11 stages in the required order with expected titles; PUT /api/site/content forces the 11 fixed titles even when client sends tampered titles, persists desc updates, rejects invalid count with HTTP 400, and denies non-super_admin (admin returned 403). Frontend: Landing #alur renders 11 interactive step cards + 10 sequential arrows; desktop hover and keyboard focus update the full-width bottom description panel (verified steps 3, 6, 8); nav anchor #alur works; on mobile the description panel is auto-visible for active stage (starts at Tahap 01 - Pembuatan Akun), tapping steps 5 and 11 updates active title/desc, no horizontal overflow (0px), legacy #timeline anchor is absent. Super Admin Kelola Website > Alur Pendaftaran tab lists exactly the 11 fixed titles with 11 editable Keterangan Tahap textareas and a save button. Original CMS descriptions were captured and restored after mutation tests.
critical_code_review_comments: RegistrationFlow.jsx renders arrow-{index+1} even for the last card in a row (rowEnd branch skipping isLast), which is correct; however arrow indexing corresponds to card positions 1-3,4-6,7-9,10 giving 10 arrows total - matches spec.

normalize_registration_flow silently overrides client-supplied titles rather than returning validation error - acceptable per requirement but consider logging when titles differ from defaults for auditability.

DEFAULT_SITE_CONTENT still contains a legacy `timeline` array (8 items) which is stored but no longer rendered on landing; safe to keep for backward compatibility but consider removing later to avoid confusion.
seed_data_creation: None. CMS registration_flow descriptions were temporarily overwritten with TEST desc strings then restored to original values captured at test start.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Alur Pendaftaran feature verified working per spec across desktop/mobile and CMS editor. Backend regression suite for this feature: /app/backend/tests/test_registration_flow_cms.py.
